name: Osceola Gold, Inc.
summary: Osceola Gold, Inc. specializes in the extraction of valuable metals. This firm's core business involves identifying, evaluating, and advancing initiatives centered on deposits of gold and other precious minerals. It possesses claims for mining within the Osceola Mining district, specifically located in Mary Ann Canyon, an area found approximately 30 miles northward from Ely, Nevada. The company's corporate headquarters are situated in Weirton, West Virginia.
